<menupopup id="calTasksMenuPopup">
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterTasks"
              type="checkbox"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-tasks-view-filtertasks"/>
    <menuseparator id="calTasksViewSeparator"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterCurrent"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="throughcurrent"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-current"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterToday"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="throughtoday"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-today"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterNext7days"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="throughsevendays"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-next7days"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterNotstartedtasks"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="notstarted"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-notstarted"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterOverdue"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="overdue"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-overdue"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterCompleted"
              name="filtergroup"
              type="radio"
              value="completed"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-completed"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterOpen"
              name="filtergroup"
              type="radio"
              value="open"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-open"/>
    <menuitem id="calTasksViewFilterAll"
              name="filtergroup"
              value="all"
              type="radio"
              data-l10n-id="calendar-task-filter-all"/>
  </menupopup>
